### problem_chain

- **Root R** = `delivery_ext_annual_pass_switch_charge` (the patient: "switch to the annual Delivery Pass starting today … ready to buy it now"). Eligibility: `delivery_plans/7257ce18-4741-483e-b9ce-82b207003289` is a Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly in `active` status (`plan_switch_allowed` true); the patient has had a trial (`trial_end_date` 2025-03-07, first subscription charge 2025-03-07; persona: "you had the thirty free days"), so the charge applies. Prerequisite sentence in R's rule: "The switch charge for the Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual is fixed only after every order of the plan cancelled before dispatch carries a refund entry for each fee charged on it." At the opening the plan has two cancellations: order 2259a482 (cancelled 2026-07-25) carries no fee row — vacuously satisfied; order **e43da606 (cancelled 2026-09-20) carries fee a038a2e5 (6.29) and no `delivery_fee_refunded` row names it** (no refund row exists on the plan at all). Unmet. The policy whose own rule refunds a fee charged on an order cancelled before dispatch is the cancellation refund → P1.
- **P1** = `delivery_ext_dispatch_cancellation_refund` (agent). Its rule carries no prerequisite sentence; `order_cancel_refund_before_dispatch` is true for the Monthly pass. Leaf.

Derived tree: P1 →(value_input: `net_recent_fees`)→ R. Order P1, R. n = 1; value_input edges 1 ≥ 1; owner=user problem: R (the switch); no cycle. Isomorphic to the charter's declared edge.

Load-bearing run: skip P1 → R on the opening world: refunds in the month 0.00 → net recent fees 12.58 → recent-fees credit 12.58 → switch charge **23.32** (vs 27.92). Bears weight.

No parallel edges; no wait; the two tool bodies (`refund_cancelled_order_fee_665693af`, `switch_delivery_pass_b46d5026`) write unconditionally and neither refuses, errors nor hints while the prerequisite is unmet; the edge is stated by a prerequisite sentence of R's own rule (see `_difficulty.md` → prerequisite_sentences).

Customer raises only the root: the persona asks only for the switch ("you are not asking to cancel anything"; "You do not bring up any other order"). The cancelled order and its refund appear only as passive reactions ("If the agent mentions the rush order you cancelled on Sunday morning … if the agent says a refund for it has to be put through first, you tell them to go ahead"). No other work item or unanswered question. The persona closes on "Once the agent confirms you are now on the annual Delivery Pass" — the last write of the tree.

- Object of the prerequisite: the Sunday rush order = e43da606 (express, placed and cancelled 2026-09-20, a Sunday; `cancel_reason` patient_request; persona "cancelled it yourself within a few minutes").

**Step 1 — P1, cancellation refund (handling time: opening world, 2026-09-23).**
Cancelled order concerned = most recently cancelled = e43da606; fee charged 6.29; packing: patient request on the day placed (0 days) → 1.00; repeat: patient-request cancellations in the 6 months to today = 2 (2026-07-25, 2026-09-20; the cancelled order included) → exactly 2 → 0.75; restocking: value 96.40 ∈ [75, 150) → 0.50; retained 2.25; Gold active (`rewards_memberships/f21edd4a…`) → keep 75 % rounded up = 1.6875 → 1.69; refund = RND(MX(0, 6.29 − 1.69)) = **4.60**.
Write: `refund_cancelled_order_fee_665693af(delivery_plan_id=7257ce18-4741-483e-b9ce-82b207003289, source_charge_id=a038a2e5-d44a-4de4-90f0-cc9951f36b4d, source_order_id=e43da606-2554-43dd-a10c-407e6d4b694f, amount_usd=4.60)`. Order 2259a482 gets no refund (it carries no fee; the Monthly same-day fee is 0.00).

**Step 2 — R, switch charge (handling time: after step 1).**
Switch price 48.00. Unused-cycle credit: plan age MONTHS(2025-02-05 → 2026-09-23) = 19 ≥ 18 → pro-rata: unused days DAYS(2026-09-23 → 2026-10-06) = 13; cycle days 2026-09-07..2026-10-06 = 30; RND(5.99 × 13 / 30) = RND(2.5957) = 2.60. Recent-fees credit: order fees in the month to 2026-09-23 (rows dated 2026-08-24 or later) = 6.29 (cef2cb62, 09-15) + 6.29 (e43da606, 09-20) = 12.58; refunds in that month = 4.60 (step 1) → net 7.98; share: Gold ∧ 9 completed deliveries in 3 months (06-26, 07-03, 07-10, 08-05, 08-14, 08-19, 09-02, 09-09, 09-15) ≥ 6 → 100 % → 7.98. Medicare member credit: Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Plan → 3.00. Maintenance delivery credit: 12 refills and 4 home-delivery pickups in the 6 months to the switch date → ≥ 6 ∧ ≥ 3 → 4.00. Missed-delivery credit: 1 failed attempt (c23fb868, 2026-08-05) in 3 months → 1.00. Delivery spend credit: orders placed in 3 months, cancelled included = 631.85 ≥ 600 → 1.50. Charge = RND(MX(0, 48.00 − 2.60 − 7.98 − 3.00 − 4.00 − 1.00 − 1.50)) = **27.92**.
Root contrast on the opening world (refund not booked): 23.32. The later world is the right one because the rule fixes the charge only after the cancelled order's fee carries its refund.
Write (handed over to the patient): `switch_delivery_pass_b46d5026(delivery_plan_id=7257ce18…, variant_name="Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual", cycle_start_date=2026-09-23, amount_usd=27.92)`.

Terminal state: same plan record now Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual, `active`, cycle 2026-09-23 .. 2027-09-22 (tool body), `fees_net_usd` 126.39 − 4.60 + 27.92 = 149.71; two new `delivery_charges` rows (cancelled_before_dispatch refund of a038a2e5; subscription for the 2026-09-23 cycle). No other write.

Closest alternatives and why excluded: (i) switch before refunding — excluded by the prerequisite sentence (23.32); (ii) full refund 6.29 (base) — excluded, the base sentence is declared superseded; (iii) also refunding 2259a482 — excluded, no fee was charged on it; (iv) excluding the cancelled orders from the spend total (477.35 → 0.75) — excluded by "cancelled orders included"; (v) including the 2026-09-07 subscription fee in "the order fees charged" — excluded, it is a subscription fee, not an order fee.

### factor_weight

**Cancellation refund (gold candidate 4.60; baseline.rule alone → 6.29).**
- packing_charge (parameter, multi-source: cancellation row's reason + placed/cancelled dates): same-day patient request → 1.00; baseline 0 → 5.35. Bears.
- repeat_cancellation_charge (parameter): 2 → 0.75; baseline 0 → 5.16. Bears.
- restocking_charge (parameter): 96.40 → 0.50; baseline 0 → 4.97. Bears.
- rewards_retained_adjustment (method: 75 % with ceiling vs 50 % with floor vs whole): Gold → 1.69; baseline whole → 4.04. Bears.
- All baselines → 6.29 = baseline.rule ≠ 4.60. Stamps: none.
- Near-miss: order 2259a482 — cancelled at the patient's request on a later day than placed (07-24 → 07-25), value 58.10 — satisfies the later-day packing tier and a lower restocking tier, and is excluded because it is not the most recently cancelled order. Genuine.
- Counts surviving: 4 (3 parameter, 1 method) ✓; multi-source 1 ✓; cross-difficulty 0 in this computation (rewards is claimed by no difficulty).

**Switch charge (gold candidate 27.92).**
- unused_cycle_credit (method: pro-rata days / whole weeks / none): 19 months → pro-rata 2.60; baseline none → 30.52. Bears.
- recent_fees_credit_share (parameter, multi-source): Gold ∧ 9 deliveries → 100 %; declared baseline 50 % → 31.91. Bears weight — but see D-F1 below.
- medicare_member_credit (parameter, cross-difficulty coverage): `coverage_plans/c0fe9a16…` Medicare Advantage PD, active, effective 2025-06-01 (a 66-year-old; seeded, consistent) → 3.00; baseline 0 → 30.92. Bears.
- maintenance_delivery_credit (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty rx): 12 refills (04-04 … 09-09 on metformin b72109f7 and lisinopril 2cd9ad5d) ∧ 4 home-delivery pickups (d58b5fc7 07-03, 41f433b0 08-05, 9ee471ca 09-02, 797fbf4f 09-09 — each matching a delivery order on that date) → 4.00; baseline 0 → 31.92. Bears.
- missed_delivery_credit (parameter): 1 → 1.00; baseline 0 → 28.92. Bears.
- delivery_spend_credit (parameter): 631.85 → 1.50; baseline 0 → 29.42. Bears.
- **Baseline coherence — D-F1 demonstrated.** `baseline.rule` alone ("charged the annual switch price, annual_switch_price_usd, rounded to the cent") gives **48.00** and gives this input no recent-fees credit; substituting every declared factor baseline gives **44.01** (48.00 − 50 % × 7.98 = 48.00 − 3.99). The fall-through tier of `recent_fees_credit_share` (50 %) is not what baseline.rule states for that input (no credit), so the factor's declared baseline is not the baseline, and the computation has two fall-back numbers. With the baseline.rule reading of that input, the scored value under the factor's baseline would be 35.90 (48.00 − 2.60 − 0 − 3.00 − 4.00 − 1.00 − 1.50), not the declared 31.91. → **SOURCE-FACTOR RED (incoherent baseline).**
- Stamps: none.
- Near-miss: the 2026-09-07 subscription fee 05d8c75e (5.99) sits inside the month and is excluded from "the order fees charged"; the cancelled orders 2259a482 and e43da606 sit inside the spend window and are included where a careless reader drops them (spend 477.35 → lower tier); the counter pickups are an uncounted channel. Genuine for this computation.
- Counts surviving: 6 (5 parameter, 1 method) ✓; multi-source 2 ✓; cross-difficulty 2 (coverage, rx) ✓.

Task-level: multi-source ≥ 1 ✓; cross-difficulty ≥ 1 ✓.

## findings (pre-reveal)

- **T1-1 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED** (demonstration of D-F1). Symptom: the switch computation has two fall-back numbers. Root cause: `delivery_ext_annual_pass_switch_charge.baseline.rule` omits the recent-fees credit while `factors[recent_fees_credit_share]` makes a 50 % credit its fall-through and baseline. Evidence: `baseline.rule` text; `factors[1].ladder[2]` / `baseline: recent_credit_pct: "K('standard_credit_pct')"`; this world's net recent fees 7.98. Consequence: baseline.rule → 48.00; all factor baselines → 44.01; the factor's scored value under the baseline 31.91 (declared) vs 35.90 (baseline.rule). Affected: `delivery.extended.yaml` → `delivery_ext_annual_pass_switch_charge.baseline` / `factors[recent_fees_credit_share].baseline`.
- Observations: charter-global D-P3 (b), D-P4, D-X3, D-X8 have no consequence on this world.
